description: A speaking attribute with a word, written into a BASE's host block and inherited by the marker — the merge proved by the one kind of attribute the reference cannot carry, since a word is a violation by itself. Without the merge, the package's `aria-label` on `PctMarker` has no counterpart in the source read and point 2 fires instead of point 3. The entry in `package.json` is the one the linker writes, so that point 2 agrees and the defect is the declared one alone.
